title: The Judaica Press complete Tanach with Rashi, translated by A. J. Rosenberg
text: the ridicule of the complacent [With] the ridicule of the complacent heathens we are sated.
the contempt that they despised the valley of doves, which is Jerusalem.
the complacent Heb. לגאיונים. It is written as one word and read as two.
